title: Hospital Management Portal (HMP)
description: A secure, self-service platform for patients to manage appointments and access medical records, doctors to manage schedules and update patient EHRs, and administrators to oversee operations and ensure compliance.
generatedDescription: A comprehensive Hospital Management Portal enabling patients, doctors, and administrators to securely manage healthcare interactions, records, and operations. It streamlines appointment scheduling, medical record access, and secure communication while ensuring HIPAA compliance.

items.name: patient
items.description: Manages personal profile, schedules appointments, accesses medical records and visit summaries.

items.name: doctor
items.description: Manages clinical schedule, views and updates patient medical records, tracks appointment requests.

items.name: admin
items.description: Oversees system, manages users, monitors appointment activity, ensures data integrity, configures system settings.

items.title: Patient Appointment Scheduling
items.description: Patients shall be able to securely schedule, view, and manage their appointments with doctors.

items.title: Doctor Schedule Management
items.description: Doctors shall be able to manage their clinical availability and view their scheduled appointments.

items.title: Medical Record Access (Patient)
items.description: Patients shall be able to securely access their own medical records and visit summaries.

items.title: Medical Record Management (Doctor)
items.description: Doctors shall be able to view and update medical records for their assigned patients.

items.title: Secure Patient-Doctor Messaging
items.description: Patients and their assigned doctors shall be able to exchange confidential and auditable messages within the portal.

items.title: Appointment Request Tracking
items.description: Doctors shall be able to track and respond to pending appointment requests from patients.

items.title: System Configuration Management
items.description: Administrators shall be able to configure hospital-specific settings such as operating hours, holidays, and policies.

items.title: Data Export for Reporting
items.description: Administrators shall be able to generate and export reports on appointments, user engagement, and communication metrics in formats like CSV/PDF.

items.title: Consent Management
items.description: The system shall manage patient consent for various policies, data usage, and privacy agreements.

items.title: Patient Data Rights Fulfillment
items.description: The system shall process patient requests for data access, correction, and deletion in compliance with data protection laws.

items.title: EHR/LIS/Insurance Integration
items.description: The system shall integrate with existing hospital systems (EHR, LIS, insurance platforms) using RESTful and FHIR-based APIs for data exchange.

items.title: Appointment Webhook Notifications
items.description: The system shall send real-time webhook notifications to external systems for appointment-related events (e.g., creation, update, cancellation).

items.title: Messaging Webhook Notifications
items.description: The system shall send real-time webhook notifications to external systems for messaging events (e.g., new message received).

items.title: PHI Access Audit Logging
items.description: The system shall record detailed audit logs for all access to Protected Health Information (PHI) to ensure compliance.

items.title: PHI Modification Audit Logging
items.description: The system shall record detailed audit logs for all modifications to Protected Health Information (PHI) to ensure compliance.

items.name: Patient
items.description: Personal and contact information for a patient, linked to a system user.

items.name: Doctor
items.description: Professional and contact information for a doctor, linked to a system user.

items.name: Appointment
items.description: A scheduled or requested patient visit with a doctor.

items.name: MedicalRecord
items.description: A patient's health information, including diagnoses, treatments, medications, and visit notes.

items.name: VisitSummary
items.description: A concise summary of a patient's visit, often derived from their medical record.

items.name: Message
items.description: A secure and auditable communication between a patient and their assigned doctor.

items.name: DoctorSchedule
items.description: A doctor's defined availability for appointments.

items.name: HospitalConfig
items.description: System-wide configurable settings for the hospital, such as operating hours, holidays, and policies.

items.name: Consent
items.description: Records a patient's consent for various policies or data usage.

items.name: scheduleAppointment
items.description: Handles the process of a patient requesting an appointment, checking doctor availability, and potentially notifying the doctor for approval.

items.name: approveAppointment
items.description: Allows a doctor to approve a pending appointment request, updating its status and notifying the patient.

items.name: updateMedicalRecord
items.description: Handles the complex logic for updating a patient's medical record, including validation, versioning, and audit logging.

items.name: sendMessage
items.description: Sends a secure message between a patient and their assigned doctor, ensuring the sender and receiver are linked and logging the communication.

items.name: generateReport
items.description: Generates a configurable report (e.g., appointments, user engagement) for administrators, potentially in CSV/PDF format.

items.name: exportData
items.description: Exports specified data in a given format (CSV/PDF) for analysis or compliance purposes.

items.name: handlePatientDataRequest
items.description: Processes patient requests for data access, correction, or deletion, ensuring compliance with privacy regulations.

items.name: syncEHRData
items.description: Integrates with an external EHR system to synchronize patient and medical record data, potentially using FHIR standards.

items.name: syncLISData
items.description: Integrates with an external LIS (Laboratory Information System) to exchange lab results and update medical records.

items.name: processInsuranceClaim
items.description: Integrates with an external insurance platform to process claims related to completed appointments.

items.name: notifyAppointmentWebhook
items.description: Sends a webhook notification to configured external systems when an appointment event (create, update, delete) occurs.

items.name: notifyMessageWebhook
items.description: Sends a webhook notification to configured external systems when a new secure message is sent.

items.name: logPHIReadAccess
items.description: Records an audit log entry whenever a user accesses Protected Health Information (PHI) from a MedicalRecord.

items.name: logPHIModification
items.description: Records an audit log entry whenever Protected Health Information (PHI) within a MedicalRecord is modified.

items.name: queryDoctorSchedule
items.description: Retrieves a doctor's availability schedule for a given period.

items.name: queryHospitalConfig
items.description: Retrieves specific hospital configuration settings.

items.name: queryMedicalRecord
items.description: Retrieves a patient's medical record or specific parts of it.

items.name: EHRSystem
items.description: Integrate with existing Electronic Health Record systems for patient and medical data exchange (REST/FHIR).

items.name: LISSystem
items.description: Integrate with Laboratory Information Systems for lab results exchange (REST/FHIR).

items.name: InsurancePlatform
items.description: Integrate with insurance platforms for claims processing and verification (REST/FHIR).

items.name: appointmentAssistant
items.description: Assists patients with scheduling appointments, checking doctor availability, and answering common questions about hospital services and policies.

items.name: medicalRecordSummarizer
items.description: Provides doctors with concise summaries of a patient's medical history from their EHR, highlighting key diagnoses, treatments, and medications for quick review.

items.title: Patient Portal
items.description: Patients can log in to manage their personal profile, view and schedule appointments, access their medical records and visit summaries, and communicate with their assigned doctor.

items.title: Doctor Dashboard
items.description: Doctors can view and manage their clinical schedule, track pending appointment requests, access and update patient medical records, and communicate securely with patients.

items.title: Admin Dashboard
items.description: Administrators can monitor overall system activity, manage user accounts (patients and doctors), oversee appointment activity, configure hospital-wide settings, and generate various reports.

items.title: Secure Messaging
items.description: A dedicated interface for patients and doctors to exchange secure, confidential, and auditable messages related to patient care.
